articles.summary: Ad duplication costs marketers up to 10% of their media budgets. By breaking down video silos and unifying CTV with digital channels, brands can manage cross-screen frequency, eliminate ad waste, and turn consistent exposures into higher purchase intent.
articles.title: Breaking Down the Silos: Building an Omnichannel Connected TV Strategy

articles.summary: Crowded social feeds mean up to 27% of younger audiences actively tune ads out. By transporting your top creator and social-first assets into CTV and trusted editorial environments, you can extend creative shelf-life, tap into higher consumer trust, and unlock incremental reach.
articles.title: The Amplification Shift: From Walled Gardens to Premium Media
